name: Stellos
about: Stellos (class 1047), the blind elder of the Order of Enlightenment on Argentrock, over two hundred years old; his last scene follows the taking of the Breath of Air (G[568:1]). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: If a focus is only a channel, where does the danger lie?
say: Ah. It is good for a Child of Stratos to seek knowledge. And that is a deep question, friend.
The channel is silver, forged and blessed. It does not tire and it does not want. The danger is always in the one who holds it.
A healer who is unsteady reaches too deeply into her power, and it pours through him faster than he can bear. A wider channel only makes the flood swifter.
Some of the young believe two channels would carry twice the power. Perhaps they would. I have never met a heart that could carry twice as much. Mine can barely carry what it has.
